summary: Verified the stale-clarification-artifact fix via comprehensive Vitest-based testing. Added 2 new integration tests to cli-planner.test.ts: (1) 'clears all stale artifact types before replanning' — verifies that plan_draft.md, scout_report.json, execution_plan.json, planning_raw_output.txt, and node_specs/ are all removed before the second planning attempt runs, with an in-mock assertion that throws if any stale file survives; (2) 'handles triple replan: clarification → clarification → success' — exercises three sequential runCliPlanning calls on the same runId, confirming each clarification is isolated and the third attempt succeeds without being blocked by stale artifacts from attempts 1 or 2. All verification gates pass: pnpm build (clean), pnpm lint (0 errors), pnpm vitest run src/goal/cli-planner.test.ts (12/12 pass), pnpm vitest run src/goal/ (351/351 pass, 7 skipped). Live CLI runtime verification (systemctl restart + interactive goal new) cannot be performed from within this worker session due to hard deny on systemctl --user restart and nested Claude Code prevention, but the fix is thoroughly validated at the unit/integration test level.
